scope: Final explanatory robustness to overlapping H=20 labels; not model selection or a replacement for main results
representative_prediction: Each original seed probability > original saved threshold, then >=3 positive votes among all five seeds; never probability averaging

sampling.sort: chronological existing frozen test prediction rows

Persistence: Exact saved full-test Persistence predictions, independently matched to original Close(t)>Close(t-20) definition

McNemar.primary_p: max(exact binomial p, continuity-corrected chi-square p)

independence_limit: Reduced label overlap does not guarantee complete serial independence; smaller N reduces power
